claim: The one-click demo loads sample data in separate storage and discards it when the visitor starts for real.
where: landing action, demo banner, Privacy, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed normal IndexedDB; enter /demo; edit and reset; exit; assert normal value survives and demo database is deleted

claim: The reader and demo are free to use without an account or checkout.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert no identity or payment controls and complete a speech action

claim: The web image reader keeps chosen images and recognized text on this device and sends no cross-origin requests during reading.
where: landing facts, privacy section, Privacy, README
sandbox: fresh /demo context; record the entire OCR flow request log; assert every request is same-origin and reader state is in demo IndexedDB

claim: The web image reader recognizes English text from the shipped sample on this device.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; run the bundled Tesseract worker and model; assert the observed text contains the sample words

claim: The web image reader accepts supported images up to 20 MB and rejects larger files.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; choose a generated 20 MB plus one byte PNG payload; assert the size error

claim: Users can export and import saved reader text and settings as JSON.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; export edited text and inspect JSON; import a valid fixture and assert restored text

claim: The installed web image reader works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; wait for service worker control; switch context offline; reload and assert seeded demo remains usable

claim: The Android companion requests screen-share approval, does not inspect accessibility trees, and recognizes and speaks text on-device.
where: landing steps, privacy section, Privacy, Terms, README
sandbox: clean source checkout; inspect the bound service metadata, MediaProjection consent path, ML Kit client, and Android TextToSpeech construction

claim: The Android companion remembers the last selection and reading for repeat.
sandbox: clean source checkout; assert the service uses RegionMemory and persists and reads the last spoken text

claim: TapRead does not bypass Android protected-screen controls and refuses likely blank protected captures.
sandbox: clean source checkout; assert the native protected-buffer refusal path is present
